title: Guardians of the Rift
text: Runecraft-focused activity in the Temple of the Eye. Great points and unique rewards. See the wiki for rotation info and tips.

title: Tempoross
text: Fishing boss (‘Colossus of the Sea’). Chill group-friendly activity with solid Fishing XP and reward caskets.

title: Wintertodt
text: Firemaking boss in the north. Excellent early FM XP with supply crates and uniques.

title: Pest Control
text: Team-based combat defense game for Void Knight points and Void gear.

title: Barbarian Assault
text: Co-op wave defense with distinct roles (Attacker, Defender, Healer, Collector). Unlock Fighter torso and more.

title: Castle Wars
text: Capture-the-flag PvP with catapults, barricades, and tickets for cosmetics.

title: Soul Wars
text: Large-scale PvP/PvM hybrid for Zeal points (imbues, Slayer XP, cosmetics).

title: Last Man Standing
text: Battle-royale style PvP in instanced arenas with standardized gear and supplies.

title: Trouble Brewing
text: Brewing minigame on Mos Le’Harmless for The Cream outfit and cosmetics.

title: Pyramid Plunder
text: High-intensity Thieving in Sophanem pyramids; great XP with scepter chance.

title: Sorceress's Garden
text: Stealthy seasonal gardens for Thieving/Herblore resources.

title: Mage Training Arena
text: Four rooms with unique spell challenges to earn Pizazz points and magic gear.

title: Barrows
text: Combat puzzle with six Barrows brothers; chance at set pieces and runes.

title: Fishing Trawler
text: Co-op fishing voyage for Angler outfit and unique fish.

title: Tithe Farm
text: Farming minigame in Hosidius for points (seed box, farmer’s outfit).

title: Motherlode Mine
text: AFK-friendly Mining with pay-dirt veins; Golden nuggets for upgrades.

title: Blast Furnace
text: Fast Smithing method with reduced bars per ore; foreman fee below 60 Smithing.

title: Giants' Foundry
text: Smith bespoke giant swords for points and unique smithing rewards.

title: Hallowed Sepulchre
text: High-skill Agility course with traps and coffins; strong GP/hr and ring upgrades.

title: Temple Trekking / Burgh de Rott Ramble
text: Escort minigame through Morytania; supplies, XP tomes, and unique cosmetics.

title: Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup
text: Cut jungle, repair fences, and gain favor for trading sticks.

title: Tears of Guthix
text: Weekly cave activity: gather blue tears for XP in your lowest skill.

title: Gnome Restaurant
text: Delivery minigame for the Grand Tree; food rewards and gracefulness training.

title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
text: Ticket-based Agility arena with rotating pillars and trap obstacles.

title: Warriors' Guild
text: Combat mini-activities for tokens and Dragon defender grind.

title: Rogues' Den
text: Maze-like thieving/agility course for Rogue outfit.

title: TzHaar Fight Cave
text: Endurance PvM challenge culminating in TzTok-Jad (Fire cape).

title: TzHaar Fight Pit
text: Free-for-all PvP arena with Tokkul rewards.

title: Shades of Mort'ton
text: Rebuild the temple and cremate shades for keys and loot.

title: Blast Mining
text: Lovakengj activity using dynamite to extract ore for good Mining XP/GP.

title: Shooting Stars
text: Track and mine fallen stars around Gielinor; celestial shards and XP.

title: Volcanic Mine
text: High-level group Mining on Fossil Island with risk-reward mechanics.

title: Mahogany Homes
text: Construction contracts around Gielinor for points and carpentry rewards.

title: Guardians of the Void (PC variant events)
text: Occasional Pest Control style variants/events. Use regular Pest Control if unavailable.

title: LMS (Casual)
text: Unranked queue for Last Man Standing. Good practice without rating changes.

title: LMS (Ranked)
text: Ranked queue for Last Man Standing with rating and leaderboard.

title: Chambers of Xeric (CoX)
text: OSRS’s first raid. Randomised rooms leading to **The Great Olm**. Supports solo to very large teams.

title: Chambers of Xeric (Challenge Mode)
text: Harder variant of CoX with fixed room set and timed completion for cosmetic rewards.

title: Theatre of Blood (ToB)
text: Linear, mechanics-heavy raid in Ver Sinhaza. Six encounters ending with **Verzik Vitur**.

title: Theatre of Blood: Hard Mode
text: Harder, remixed mechanics and timing challenges. Cosmetic unlocks and unique pet recolours.

title: Tombs of Amascut (ToA)
text: Invocation-based raid with scalable difficulty. Encounters include **Akkha, Ba-Ba, Kephri, Zebak**, finale **Warden(s)**.

title: Nex
text: Zarosian general in the Ancient Prison (God Wars Dungeon). Team-focused five-phase fight.

title: General Graardor (Bandos GWD)
text: Bandos boss in the God Wars Dungeon. Heavy melee damage and minions.

title: Kree'arra (Armadyl GWD)
text: Ranged-heavy Armadyl boss with strong knockback specials.

title: Commander Zilyana (Saradomin GWD)
text: Fast Saradomin boss with high magic/melee pressure and minions.

title: K'ril Tsutsaroth (Zamorak GWD)
text: Zamorak boss with prayer-smash special and strong melee/magic damage.

title: Corporeal Beast
text: Mass-friendly spectral beast weak to **Stab** and **Bandos godsword**/DWH specs; avoids non-spec damage with Core mechanics.

title: Zulrah
text: Solo rotation boss with phase patterns and venom. Great unique drops (**Serp helm**, **Toxic bow**, etc.).

title: Vorkath
text: Post-quest repeatable dragon boss with special attacks (acid, freeze, bomb). Lucrative uniques.

title: The Nightmare of Ashihama
text: Group boss with totems, parasite/curse mechanics and phase transitions.

title: Phosani's Nightmare
text: Harder solo instance of The Nightmare with tightened timings and additional mechanics.

title: Duke Sucellus
text: One of the **Desert Treasure II** bosses. Arcane projectile & potion mechanics; unique rings.

title: The Leviathan
text: DT2 boss with wave walls and projectile patterns; learnable movement checks.

title: The Whisperer
text: DT2 siren boss with sanity/orb mechanics and shadow pools.

title: Vardorvis
text: DT2 melee-pressure boss with grab/line attacks and axe throws.

title: The Gauntlet
text: Timed prep dungeon culminating in **Crystalline Hunllef**. Great for practice and crystal loot.

title: The Corrupted Gauntlet
text: Harder Gauntlet variant with tighter prep and Hunllef checks; higher reward potential.

title: Dagannoth Kings (Rex, Prime, Supreme)
text: Tri-boss arena with combat triangle weaknesses; rings & bones/skins uniques.

title: Kalphite Queen (KQ)
text: Two-phase boss (form swaps prayers). Iconic desert encounter.

title: King Black Dragon (KBD)
text: Classic dragon boss with multiple breath types; accessible for mid-level PvM.

title: Giant Mole
text: Burrowing boss under Falador Park; beginner-friendly money maker.

title: Sarachnis
text: Mid-level spider boss in Forthos Dungeon; supply-focused loot and pet chance.

title: Phantom Muspah
text: Shapeshifting boss with prayer swaps and spike phase. Strong ranged/magic checks.

title: Callisto (Multi Wilderness)
text: Bear boss with heavy melee & pushback. High PK risk; team recommended.

title: Artio (Singles+ Wilderness)
text: Callisto’s singles variant in lower Wilderness. Safer access for soloers.

title: Venenatis (Multi Wilderness)
text: Spider boss with web snares and ranged pressure.

title: Spindel (Singles+ Wilderness)
text: Venenatis’s singles variant with toned stats but similar mechanics.

title: Vet'ion (Multi Wilderness)
text: Undead champion with hounds and shockwaves. High-value uniques.

title: Calvar'ion (Singles+ Wilderness)
text: Singles variant of Vet’ion; refined mechanics and reduced stats.

title: Chaos Elemental
text: Randomized disarm/teleport effects; deep Wilderness roaming boss.

title: Chaos Fanatic
text: Wilderness demi-boss with magic AoE and green orb spec.

title: Crazy Archaeologist
text: Wilderness demi-boss with explosive books and ranged attacks.

title: Scorpia
text: Wilderness scorpion boss with healing guardians; magic recommended.

title: TzHaar Fight Cave
text: Wave challenge culminating in **TzTok-Jad** for the **Fire cape**.

title: The Inferno
text: Endgame wave challenge culminating in **TzKal-Zuk** for the **Infernal cape**.

title: Bryophyta
text: F2P moss giant boss (key-based) with beginner-friendly mechanics.

title: Obor
text: F2P hill giant boss (key-based); simple melee-focused fight.

title: Fortis Colosseum
text: Wave-based PvM in **Varlamore** with **Glory** scoring and escalating difficulty.
